title: Stalk of a presheaf of modules on a topological space, as a module over the stalk of the rings
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $x\in X$, $\mathcal O$ a presheaf of rings on $X$ and $\mathcal P$ a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules (a presheaf of abelian groups with an $\mathcal O(U)$-module structure on each $\mathcal P(U)$, the restriction maps being semilinear over those of $\mathcal O$). The open neighbourhoods of $x$, ordered by reverse inclusion, form a directed set ($U\cap V$ lies below $U$ and $V$). The *stalk* $\mathcal P_x=\varinjlim_{U\ni x}\mathcal P(U)$ is the colimit of the abelian groups $\mathcal P(U)$ over this directed set [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with coprojections $s\mapsto s_x$ (the *germ* of $s\in\mathcal P(U)$); likewise $\mathcal O_x=\varinjlim_{U\ni x}\mathcal O(U)$ is a ring with germs $r\mapsto r_x$. Every element of $\mathcal P_x$ is a germ $s_x$, and $s_x=s'_x$ for $s\in\mathcal P(U)$, $s'\in\mathcal P(U')$ iff $s|_W=s'|_W$ for some open $x\in W\subseteq U\cap U'$. $\mathcal P_x$ is an $\mathcal O_x$-module by $r_x\cdot s_x=(r|_W\,s|_W)_x$ for $r\in\mathcal O(U)$, $s\in\mathcal P(U')$, $x\in W\subseteq U\cap U'$ (independent of the choices); in particular $(rs)_x=r_x\,s_x$ for $r\in\mathcal O(U)$, $s\in\mathcal P(U)$. For a scheme $X$ and an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ this makes $\mathcal F_x$ an $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-module. A morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules $\varphi:\mathcal P\to\mathcal Q$ induces the $\mathcal O_x$-linear map $\varphi_x:\mathcal P_x\to\mathcal Q_x$, $s_x\mapsto\varphi(s)_x$.
